# Executive Alignment Report

## Executive Summary

The diagnostic pass successfully loaded Alignments.xlsx, Components.xlsx, and To-Be-Crosswalked.xlsx, then compared all 25 To-Be-Crosswalked component descriptions against all 7,339 Components component descriptions. The scoring pass excluded self-mapping pairs with similarity equal to 1.0. The starting threshold was 0.64; the first threshold with one or more non-self pairs was 0.640000, producing 2 pairs at or above that threshold. To satisfy the forty-row export requirement, the script then sorted all 183,475 non-self scored pairs and exported the 1000 highest-scoring alignments.

Leaders should treat these records as candidate alignments for validation, not as final policy determinations. Each candidate identifies a current component that can be managed, clarified, or evidenced to show progress toward the new To-Be requirement.

## Pair-Specific Recommendations

Matched records: To-Be-Crosswalked.xlsx row 14, `EO 14318, Accelerating Federal Permitting of Data Center Infrastructure - Section 10(c) (No Enforceable Rights)`; Components.xlsx row 7334, `EO 14320, Promoting The Export of the American AI Technology Stack - 5(c). No Rights Created`.

Communication: describe the relationship as a candidate progression alignment: the current component should be communicated as supporting delivery of the To-Be requirement where validation confirms the shared subject matter and operational dependency.
